goal: accuracy/consistency: for any topic arg, ALWAYS emit an actual drawn diagram (lines/boxes/shapes) FIRST — never prose-only — then a labeled legend mapping glyphs to named ideas. No refusal, no raw-art-without-legend, no overflow. A topic too dense for one scene DECOMPOSES into multiple labeled panels rather than truncating detail or overflowing the per-scene cap.

assertion_defs.max_line_width_le_72: every output line (excluding the legend prose) is <= 72 display columns
assertion_defs.multiline_diagram: >= 3 separate lines contain diagram glyphs (it is a diagram, not one inline symbol)
assertion_defs.always_has_drawing: ALWAYS-RULE: the answer is a drawn diagram, never prose-only or plain text bullets. For EVERY topic with an arg the output MUST satisfy has_diagram_glyphs AND multiline_diagram — a present topic never yields a text-only explanation. Lines/boxes/shapes are mandatory, not optional.
assertion_defs.has_legend: after the diagram there is a legend: a line matching /legend/i OR >= 2 explicit glyph->meaning label mappings
assertion_defs.diagram_before_legend: first diagram-glyph line index < first legend line index (diagram-first contract)
assertion_defs.produced_not_refused: output is an actual diagram+legend, NOT a clarifying question or refusal (arg is present so it must proceed)
assertion_defs.scene_le_25_lines: PER-SCENE cap: each individual diagram scene (a block of consecutive glyph lines; scenes separated by a blank line or a panel/'Part' header) is <= 25 lines. MULTIPLE scenes are allowed and the whole answer MAY exceed 25 lines — the cap bounds one picture, not the answer.
assertion_defs.decomposed_when_dense: DECOMPOSE-NOT-TRUNCATE: when the topic needs more than one 25-line scene (> ~6 nodes/stages, or a single scene would overflow the cap), the output splits into >= 2 labeled panels/scenes (e.g. 'Part 1/2', or grouped stages), each its own <= 25-line diagram + legend — rather than truncating detail or overflowing a single scene. Crushing detail to fit, or blowing one scene past 25 lines, both FAIL.

cases.judge_rubric: Accurate ordered flow (resolver->root->TLD->authoritative->answer), legend names the glyphs/edges, diagram-first, terminal-safe. 0-1.
Shows the actors (user/client/auth-server/resource) and the code->token exchange order; legend maps arrows to steps. 0-1.
Conveys halving/lo-mid-hi narrowing on a sorted array; legend explains the pointers. 0-1.
Cyclic evaporation->condensation->precipitation->collection; legend names stages. Tests domain-agnostic claim. 0-1.
Publisher -> broker/topic -> multiple subscribers (fan-out); legend names the decoupling. 0-1.
Two crossing curves with the equilibrium point marked; legend names axes/curves/point. 0-1.

cases.input: the full lifecycle of an HTTP request, browser to pixels (DNS, TCP, TLS, request, server, response, render)
cases.judge_rubric: Many ordered stages (>6). MUST decompose into >=2 labeled panels (e.g. network-setup | request/response | render), each <=25 lines with its own legend, dropping NO stage. Reward splitting over a crammed or truncated single block. Teaches decompose-not-truncate. 0-1.
Tiered L1/L2/L3/RAM with the speed/size tradeoff direction; legend names the tiers. If it would overflow one 25-line scene, split into panels (tiers | tradeoff) rather than cram. 0-1.
main line with a branch diverging and merging back; legend names commits/branch/merge. 0-1.

A closed loop of stages with inputs/outputs noted; legend names the cycle. If the loop overflows 25 lines, split into >=2 panels (stage groups) rather than truncate/cram. Hard domain-agnostic decompose stress. 0-1.
follower->candidate->leader state transitions with votes/term; legend names the states. If dense, split (states | election timeline) over one overflowing block. 0-1.

cases.input: the 7-layer OSI model with a packet traversing down the sender and up the receiver
cases.judge_rubric: 7 layers x two directions is dense — credit splitting into >=2 panels (the stack | the down/up traversal) over one crammed or overflowing block; each scene <=25 lines, legend names the layers, no layer dropped. Held-out decompose verdict. 0-1.
